Package com.eqixiac.equinix.mcp.server

package com.eqixiac.equinix.mcp.server
The embedded Equinix Intelligence MCP Server — a community Model Context Protocol server, not affiliated with or endorsed by Equinix, and unrelated to Equinix's own private-beta Fabric MCP server.

An MCP host (Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, …) launches EquinixMcpServerMain as a subprocess and speaks newline-delimited JSON-RPC over stdio — the only transport this server offers. Every tool executes through this SDK's typed domain clients and design engines under the operator's own client-credentials (EQUINIX_ACCESS_KEY / EQUINIX_SECRET_KEY); there is no browser consent flow and no separate authorization server.

Design rules the tool catalog follows:

  • a deliberately small catalog — every tool embeds engine logic (optimizer, wizard, TCO/savings, peering, latency) or cross-domain reach (portal, Network Edge, IBX SmartView); none is a 1:1 mirror of a REST endpoint;
  • domain-prefixed snake_case names (design_*, portal_*, ne_*, ibx_*);
  • read-only: no delete tools, and mutations are out of scope for this catalog — they arrive only through the Safe Mutation Broker's dry-run-first two-phase tools, registered via the same ToolRegistration seam;
  • results are structured JSON with size guards (lists are truncated to a sane cap and say so in the payload), and a tool call never hangs — external pricing lookups run under a hard timeout and degrade gracefully.

Extension seam: build a ToolRegistration (name, JSON schema, annotations, ToolHandler) and pass it to EquinixMcpServer.builder().additionalTools(...); the handler receives the parsed argument JSON and the shared ServerContext of lazily-built SDK facades.
